market.title: Tarik Skubal's Next Team
resolutionNote: Resolves to whichever team Tarik Skubal is officially on before Mar 25, 2027 - if he's still with Detroit or has retired by then, the 'Detroit Tigers' outcome resolves Yes instead.
Kalshi's own wording: "If Tarik Skubal's next team is Los Angeles D before Mar 25, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes."

Polymarket has a market on this too, but it asks a narrower question - whether a trade happens by the Aug 3, 2026 deadline specifically, defaulting to 'Detroit Tigers' if not. That's a different, nearer-term question from Kalshi's season-spanning contract, so it isn't paired here as a direct comparison - its live number is quoted in the Market Brief instead.

text: Detroit's season has come apart at the worst time: at 51-58 and games back of a wild-card spot, a blown 7-0 lead in a 12-inning loss to Baltimore this week reportedly "cemented the truth," per ESPN's Jeff Passan, that the Tigers have decided to sell their two-time reigning AL Cy Young winner before Monday's deadline.

Skubal is a pending free agent after this season, so whoever trades for him gets a two-month rental, not a long-term answer - which hasn't stopped a long list of contenders, including the Dodgers, Brewers, Yankees, Red Sox, Braves, Phillies, Rays, and Cubs.
Kalshi's market has the Dodgers as the clear favorite at around 49%, with the Brewers a distant second at 23% and Detroit itself priced at just 6% to keep him past the deadline.

Polymarket's own version of this question, which specifically asks whether a trade happens by Monday's 6pm ET deadline, currently has Detroit staying at similarly long odds - reinforcing that a trade is more likely than not, even if exactly where he lands remains wide open.
